messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=api-serving-prod-eu | symptom=high_5xx_rate | alert_id=PD-87321
PagerDuty: Alert PD-87321 triggered (auto-escalation policy). Paged: @oncall, @infra.
PagerDuty: Note: this alert will auto-resolve if rate falls below threshold for 60s.
Maria K: saw the page. jumping in — looks short but noisy. anyone seeing customer-facing errors? :thinking:
Ben R: on it, running quick checks (traces + qps). pulling traces for last 3m.
Sophie L: dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/api-serving-prod-eu?from=now-5m TO=now : small spike ~40s ago.
Ben R: quick metric query: `curl -s "https://internal-metrics/_query?svc=api-serving-prod-eu&period=5m" | jq '.errors_per_min'` -> `[0,0,12,0,0]` — single short spike.
Ben R: digging into hosts, looks like 503s concentrated from node api-server-77b (pod ip 10.4.2.9).
Maria K: logs snippet from api-server-77b: ```ERROR handleRequest: upstream kv returned 503 (cache-miss storm) at 2026-03-14T12:05:21Z
ERROR handleRequest: upstream kv timeout 504 at 2026-03-14T12:05:22Z
```
Alex P: PD auto-resolved PD-87321 after ~38s (no manual ack). marking as transient for now.
Sophie L: checked customer error inbox + SLO dashboards -> no user-visible errors, no SLO breach.
Ben R: hypothesis: a cache warmup / small coordinated miss storm after a rolling restart on cluster zone A. matching rollout activity at 12:04:40Z from deploy bot.
Maria K: mitigation attempted: scaled pool from 4 -> 6 for api-serving-prod-eu, and issued `kc exec` warm commands to prefill kv prefix for most-trafficked keys.
Ben R: after that, errors dropped back to baseline within ~30s. current 5xx = 0 in last 2m.
Incident Bot: Logged event: transient_kv_miss_storm. Created follow-up ticket RED-INC-481 for alert tuning + runbook.
Maria K: action items: (1) tune alert to require >2m sustained error rate before pagers; (2) add single-host suppression to avoid paginating on node-local blips; (3) update runbook with cache-warm steps used. :memo:
Ben R: I'll open PR in alerting repo with threshold change + add query cardinality clause. assigning to infra-signal for review.
Sophie L: adding note to the deploy run: avoid starting large cache-sensitive rollouts in peak window; add staged warm up.
Alex P: ACK on handoff. I'll watch for 30m. If it reappears, escalate to infra and trigger customer impact playbook.
Maria K: quick postmortem entry added to RED-INC-481 with metrics + logs; closing slack thread unless someone wants to keep it open. :white_check_mark:
Ben R: reactive: suggest we lower noise by suppressing alerts from a single pod IP for short windows — will add to PR.
Sophie L: sounds good. thanks everyone for the quick triage.
Alex P: ACK, monitoring.
Maria K: closing thread. (reacted :thumbsup:)
